claim_one_line: CODEX R031A/R031B VERIFIED ON THIS BENCH, THREE OF MY CLAIMS RETRACTED, AND A THIRD COLUMN THE PROGRAMME DID NOT HAVE. Owner: 'verify everything, trust nothing' -- so codex's certs were RE-RUN here (their seat is on this machine) rather than cited, and the positive lemma was re-derived independently with its own controls. RETRACTION 1 -- sigma in Q ESTABLISHES NOTHING. B1229 called RCFT rationality its ROBUST CORE and repeatedly wrote 'not a continuum'. Q IS DENSE IN R. A dense set is not a discrete one; rationality excludes nothing. Codex's r031b cert, re-run here: 'rationality alone permits arbitrarily large finite subsets of (0,1) and rational midpoints' -- PASS. Every actual reduction came from MMS's l=0 two-character class, which the 2026-09-01 citation check already showed is class-scoped and unproved for this boundary. The core was not weakly grounded; it was EMPTY. This is a plain logical error, not a scoping subtlety. RETRACTION 2 -- 'NO RECEIVER FOR k THEREFORE k = 1' IS A DEFAULT-VALUE INFERENCE FROM ABSENCE. B1228's level-forcing-by-inventory was the one piece I said survived that arc's retraction. It does not. Codex's law, adopted: ABSENCE OF A TYPED RECEIVER MEANS EITHER QUOTIENT-INVARIANCE OR UNDERDETERMINATION; IT NEVER MEANS A DEFAULT VALUE. Level blindness is underdetermination. RETRACTION 3 -- C-2 RESOLVES TO OUTCOME A, AND MY DIMENSION TELL WAS THE VERY ERROR B1231 NAMES. Codex's r031a cert re-run here: B_0 generator exponents (0,0,0,0); C12 acts by I_4 = zeta_12^0 I_4; after base change B_0 = K^4 and P(B_0) = P^3_K; K-rank 4, NOT 1. Controls bite (a primitive scalar would give orbit (1,5,7,11) and charpoly Phi_12; neither occurs). MY ERROR, EXACTLY: the identity IS a scalar, but the scalar is 1, so B_0 is a module over Q[zeta_12]/(zeta_12 - 1) = Q, NOT over Q(zeta_12). I matched dim 4 with phi(12) = 4 and inferred a module structure from two numbers agreeing -- the identification error B1231 exists to catch, committed INSIDE the analysis that motivated the discipline. The P^3 is genuinely P^3_C. CORRECTION 4 -- I-7 WAS WORSE THAN 'UNEARNED'. Verified: Gal(Q(zeta_3)/Q) has ORDER 2, not 3. C-5b described 'the object's own Z/3 (trace field Q(sqrt-3) = Q(zeta_3); the trinification)' -- listing the trace field as a source of Z/3 when its Galois group is Z/2. Codex: 'no arithmetic identification maps trace-field, trinification and fusion Z/3 data' -- THREE distinct objects, no maps. Part of I-7 conflated a Z/2 with a Z/3, which is a factual error, not merely a missing map. WHAT REPRODUCED: my c = 6 four-solution scan is confirmed independently ((A2,9),(A6,1),(D6,1), (E6,1)) -- but it is WZW-CLASS exhaustive, NOT RCFT exhaustive, and codex's control shows a rational-c family already exceeds it at size 21. THE POSITIVE, AND IT IS THE IMPORTANT PART -- THE THIRD COLUMN. Codex: 'no canonical Higgs line' does not imply 'three physical Higgs parameters'; the programme has been TREATING A SPACE OF REPRESENTATIVES AS A SPACE OF PHYSICAL PARAMETERS. The lemma, RE-DERIVED HERE INDEPENDENTLY WITH MB12 BITE: given 0 -> C -> V -> T -> 0 with dim (3,4,1), if a coupling Y annihilates C then Y factors uniquely through T, and the observable is CONSTANT across the whole splitting family -- spread EXACTLY 0.000 over 2000 random splittings; a generic Y gives spread 4.83, so the test discriminates. THREE COORDINATES, ZERO OBSERVABLE PARAMETERS. THE CLOSURE TEST, adopted: (1) identify the raw choice space; (2) identify allowed field redefinitions; (3) map choices to normalized invariant observables; (4) COUNT THE IMAGE, NOT THE SOURCE. THIS CORRECTS B1226's TYPING. My four boxes sorted by TYPE and never asked whether a parameter survives quotienting by field redefinitions. There are THREE columns, not two categories: forced structure; genuine observer-supplied values; and REPRESENTATIONAL CHOICES THAT DISAPPEAR FROM OBSERVABLES. The repo conflates the last two. AND IT ROUTES AROUND B1225 WITHOUT CONTRADICTING IT: B1225 proves no invariant can SELECT a point of P^3; quotient invariance says selection is NEVER NEEDED, because the observable does not depend on the choice. Complementary, not competing -- and the first closure mechanism proposed that does not require the naming wall to fall. NOT VERIFIED HERE, and fenced as such: the lepton connecting block vanishing at three good primes, and the (3,4,1) exact sequence itself, are codex's exact computations, still running. This arc verifies the ALGEBRA and the two retrieval certs; it does NOT verify that the actual couplings annihilate the actual connecting block. The fork codex names is the live one: that nine-entry tail/connecting block vanishes (the P^3 is a splitting artifact for both holomorphic Yukawas) or it does not (those nine entries are the exact obstruction). Gate 5 intact; nothing deleted; sigma = 1 still retracted; B1034/L154 still NO-EXHIBIT.
